title: Eventhandler when finished/rendered
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**

There is no "finished/rendered" event to do something after the hits are loaded/refreshed. The only available event is the `on.render` or `searchFunction`, but this is too early if you want to do something with the new DOM hits/filters or show something after everything is loaded

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**

A new event to be called after the search/hits are done and build. Simple `on.finished/rendered` function.

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**

With the current `on.render` or `searchFunction` this can't be achieved

**Additional context**

https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/instantsearch/js/?language=js#events
